record.question: What is the name of the 40th communication satellite of India launched by ISRO from French Guiana recently?
record.explanation: Answer A: GSAT-31. ISRO’s original GSAT-31 launch kit calls it India’s fortieth communication satellite and gives its launch by Ariane-5 from Kourou, French Guiana, on 6 February 2019. The satellite is GSAT-31. Historical/source note: An ISRO satellite launched by Arianespace’s Ariane-5 from French Guiana; the phrase launched by ISRO must not be read as an ISRO launch vehicle from an Indian pad. Reference: https://www.isro.gov.in/media_isro/pdf/GSAT-31%20Launch%20Kit.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
